d:
Get ready for a fast 30-minute low impact cardio workout featuring full-body cardio moves and interval training to help improve your cardiovascular fitness, endurance, and support your weight loss goals. This at-home cardio workout is designed to get your heart rate up without jumping or high-impact exercises.
Throughout this workout, you'll alternate between 130 BPM and 150 BPM intervals, giving you periods of moderate and faster-paced cardio. The changing intensity keeps the workout engaging while helping you challenge your fitness and burn calories.
